metadata.content:
*Your enemies suffer their fate; your allies embrace their destiny!*

| **Magic, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged)**  |        **Main action** |
|--------------------|-----------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged) 10**   | **🎯 Three creatures** |

**Effect:** You can target yourself instead of one creature with this ability. Choose one of the following effects, which lasts until the end of the encounter or until you are [dying](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/dying):

- Whenever a target makes a [power roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll), they can roll three dice and choose which two rolls to use.
- Whenever a target makes a [power roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll), they must roll three dice and use the lowest two rolls.
